title: Choose Alexandria's new world
question: The roll assigned the Circulation Record. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Circulation Record
options.lineage: library date-due slips, pocket cards and rubber date stamps
options.thesis: Your reading life as a circulation record: every start and every finish is a stamped date.
materials: coloured index card stock, one colour per status
rubber-stamp ink, uneven and slightly rotated
options.viewport: Today's date stamp set huge across the top; the books you are reading stand in their pockets as coloured cards below it.
options.risk: Tips into office-supply nostalgia if the colours or the stamped dates are set small and timid.

raised.raise: One live readout pinned to a corner: today's date on the stamp dial, the date every action will stamp.
One record held at a time: opening a card dims the rest; every figure in tabular digits.
Colour is law: each ink means one event (violet started, red finished, black returned unread), never ornament.
A strict five-step ink-density ramp: busy months read as overprinted stamps, no other tonal tokens.

options.label: The Book Spiral
options.lineage: contemporary library architecture: continuous book ramps and painted wayfinding
options.thesis: The collection as one continuous ramp of books, numbered like the stacks, with colour-coded floors.
options.viewport: Your whole library as one unbroken ramp of covers with huge painted call numbers; reading books lit chartreuse.
options.risk: Familiar 'modern institution' look; can read cold or corporate next to a personal library.

options.label: Pulp Rack
options.lineage: drugstore wire racks of painted paperbacks
options.thesis: Your collection on a spinning wire rack: spines out, the chosen ones face-out with your real numbers as cover lines.
options.viewport: A rack of tiers spinning in 3D, the book you are reading face-out with 'page 262 of 656!' as its cover line.
options.case: Fuses well: readers know the rack and face-out maps to status; weaker than the record for history and stats.
options.risk: Lurid and kitschy if overplayed; the ivory pulp ground drifts toward the cream default.

options.label: Exposed Binding
options.lineage: Coptic bindings with the chain stitch running outside the spine
options.thesis: The library as one bound volume: each year a section, the stitched spine counting every book read.
options.viewport: A spine of chain stitches down the left, one link per book; the current year lies open flat beside it.
options.case: Fuses well on identification (readers love bindings); browsing a big collection inside one volume is less clear.
options.risk: Natural linen and wood can slide back into the warm bookish default you are leaving.

options.label: Broadcast Signal
options.lineage: test cards and emergency broadcast crawls
options.thesis: The library tuned like a channel, colour bars and a running timecode.
options.viewport: A test card with the current book as the only broadcast.
options.case: Fuses poorly: readers do not identify with broadcast failure, and it hides the books.
options.kept: A live readout locked to one corner.

options.label: Gravity Rain Garden
options.thesis: Books drifting toward coloured clouds by status.
options.viewport: A garden where each status pulls books its way.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no reader connection, and lists become hard to scan.
options.kept: Colour as a law: one colour, one force.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Reading stats as particle tracks out of one collision.
options.viewport: A year as one event, books as tracks.
options.case: Fuses poorly: striking but alien to readers and to the collection.
options.kept: One event held at a time, the rest dimmed.
options.risk: Spectacle without meaning for a library.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Translucent sheets over a zone ramp.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an instrument for operators, not a library to show.
options.kept: A strict tonal ramp as the only density tokens.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A reading-tracker app done impeccably: clean cover grid, stats dashboard, sans UI.
canonCard.viewport: A cover grid under a profile header, stats as a dashboard.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other reading app by design.
